items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I went to, I think the original was Jim Robinson, Howard, Ken Howard, Paul Barnes. The drummer was Davis... That was that set up.

ctx.x: Is that before the Gypsy Tea Room or after?

That was after the Gypsy Tea Room. I went there afterwards. I went to, I think the original was Jim Robinson, Howard, Ken Howard, Paul Barnes. The drummer was Davis, the drummer, Eugene, or I knew he was playing.
Oh, he was a piano player. Davis was his last name?
